listing.name: Castlevania: Curse of Darkness — Castlevania-COD-Recomp (Neguchads)
listing.summary: This experimental project reports menus and game hooks. Full-campaign testing and fixes for texture bands, translation and the save-room arrow remain unfinished. Portcove has not confirmed gameplay. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA original-Xbox Castlevania: Curse of Darkness default.xbe and complete extracted assets. You retain the original files; Portcove has not downloaded or run the player or game files for this guide.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow build.bat to generate configuration and C++ locally using the sibling XboxXBERecomp checkout or pinned SDK fallback. Complete source setup with the project’s tools; Portcove does not install or confirm the resulting player.

warnings: This experimental project reports menus and game hooks. Full-campaign testing and fixes for texture bands, translation and the save-room arrow remain unfinished. Portcove has not confirmed gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
